Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tenta-kaibori/

At a countryside hillside managed as a nature preserve through a National Trust movement in the foothills of Tenranzan Mountain, we will dig for shellfish (かい掘) in a pond maintained as a biotope.

【Fee】
Adults and children: ¥3,000
Preschool children: ¥1,000
※Family discount available from second child onwards
(Includes guide, dispatch, pizza ingredients, etc.)

【Capacity】
15 people

【Guide】
Staff from the NPO "Tenranzan and Takuho-shuzan Nature Conservation Society"

【What to bring】
Drink, personal cup, chopsticks, towel, change of clothes, mask, hat, boots
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館ロビー（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」バス停下車徒歩3分）
summary: かい掘りするぞー! Digging for shellfish at the base of Tenranzan Mountain
